contact.table: People at a customer company who call in. Standard Dataverse Contact table; each belongs to one account.
contact.mobilephone: Mobile number; the caller is matched on this and telephone1
contact.parentcustomerid: The account (company) this person works for

account.table: Customers (companies that call in). Standard Dataverse Account table.
account.name: Company name
account.telephone1: Main phone; the caller is matched on this and telephone2/telephone3

bdm_serviceticket.table: Service tickets. Created only by a human rep, never by an agent.

bdm_equipment.table: Equipment / assets owned by an account (company)
bdm_equipment.bdm_name: Equipment name, for example CNC Mill 3
bdm_equipment.bdm_status: Operational, Degraded, Down or Under Maintenance
